Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

May 12th 1916-

Sir,

It is reported that Sun Yat Sen 孙逸仙 and his
followers intend to hold a meeting in a foreign house
in Avenue Dubail this afternoon.
It is reported that Sun Yat Sen intends to
leave his present quarters in Frenchtown and move to
the Palace Hotel soon.
The cruiser Ching Tsing 镜清 left the Arsenal
yesterday morning for Nanking. She had 100 artillery
men as well as a consignment of rifles and ammunition
on board.
The officer in charge of the police at Minghong
has reported to General Yang that the rebels and bad
characters in his district has become united and
are likely to cause trouble. He applied for troops
to assist in preserving the peace in his district.
General Yang told him that Minghong is near Shanghai
and therefore it was not necessary to send troops there.
Should trouble occur there troops could be quickly
dispatched to the place from Shanghai.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

12/5. Ash/145

S. I. D.
E. O. REG
326
1916年5月13日

编号
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年5月12日——

先生：

据报，孙逸仙及其追随者拟于今日下午在杜白路（Avenue Dubail）的一处外侨住宅内举行会议。
据报，孙逸仙打算不久后离开其目前在法租界的住所，搬入华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）。
“镜清”号巡洋舰昨晨离开兵工厂前往南京。该舰载有炮兵100名，以及一批步枪和弹药。
闵行警务负责人已向杨将军报告称，其辖区内的叛乱分子与不良之徒已相互勾结，很可能制造事端。他申请派兵协助维持其辖区的治安。
杨将军告知他，闵行邻近上海，因此无需向该地派兵。若该地发生骚乱，可从上海迅速调派军队前往。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警察总监。

5月12日。Ash/145
